title: Modi Rival Targets Key Minister Shah Over Student Crackdown
title_cn: 莫迪竞争对手因镇压学生而针对关键部长沙阿
summary: India’s main opposition Congress Party has sought the resignation of Home Minister Amit Shah, a close aide of Prime Minister Narendra Modi, over the police crackdown on student protesters in New Delhi last week.

title: Trump’s Court Losses Rack Up Millions in Legal Bills for Taxpayers
title_cn: 特朗普的法庭损失为纳税人带来了数百万美元的法律费用
summary: The US government is on the hook for potentially millions of dollars in legal bills demanded by successful challengers to some of the Trump administration’s most controversial executive actions and policies.
